content: Customer Reyansh Tiwari called agent Anjali Desai at First Guard Brokers because his health policy (HP-2024-987654) had expired on 15/08/2026. They discussed renewal options, and to lower the standard ₹12,500 premium, they agreed to drop the maternity cover and increase the deductible to ₹10,000, reducing the premium to ₹11,200. The agent secured verbal consent, renewed the policy until 15/08/2027, updated the customer's address, and informed him about the 5-7 business day claim settlement turnaround for in-network hospitals and 8 free annual tele-consultation visits.
